title: Getting started with inspercidados
text: list_datasets() reads registry ships package makes network calls. search alias, title, theme, region, keywords, use search argument list_datasets(). registered dataset short alias. aliases contain several logical resources. qualidade_ar_mare, example, ships measurements coordinates measurement points separate resources. resource may ship several file formats split year. Use list_resources() inspect resources alias without network request. Use get_dataset() download dataset alias. year, resource, format arguments narrow download.
code: list_datasets() list_datasets(search = "Mobilidade") list_resources("qualidade_ar_mare") # By alias embarques <- get_dataset("embarques_mensais")  # Filter by year in multi-year datasets pemob_2023 <- get_dataset("pemob_anual", year = 2023)  # Select one logical resource and file format pontos <- get_dataset(   "qualidade_ar_mare",   resource = "pontos",   format = "gpkg" )

text: Downloads registered dataset R tibble sf object. Identify dataset short alias; use get_dataverse() DOI URL.

title: Download a dataset from Insper Dataverse — get_dataset
code: get_dataset(   dataset,   ...,   resource = NULL,   year = NULL,   format = NULL,   docs = FALSE )

title: Download a dataset from Insper Dataverse — get_dataset
text: dataset dataset identifier. One : short alias, e.g. "iptu_sp". See list_datasets() aliases. ... Reserved future selectors. Must empty. resource name logical resource within registered dataset. NULL, resource marked default used. See list_resources() available names. year integer character year used filter files dataset contains multiple annual files (e.g. year = 2023). format optional file format, "parquet", "gpkg", "xlsx". format must available selected resource. docs Logical. TRUE, returns named list two elements: data (downloaded tibble/sf object) docs. dataset contains file whose name starts "documentacao" (e.g. "documentacao_iptu.xlsx"), file downloaded returned tibble. Otherwise docs named list metadata fetched Dataverse (title, description, authors, DOI, URL, year). Default FALSE.

title: Download a dataset from Insper Dataverse — get_dataset
text: docs = FALSE (default): tibble sf object "doi" attribute set. docs = TRUE: named list elements data docs.

title: Download a dataset from Insper Dataverse — get_dataset
text: Dataverse deposit may contain several logical resources, distributed several formats. Use resource select logical dataset format select representation. Deposits one resource, declared default, need neither argument. format omitted, spatial resources prefer GeoPackage GeoJSON; resources prefer RDS, Parquet, delimited text, Excel.
